title: Synthetic data generation model using GAN for associative models
summary: A GAN-based synthetic data generator for transactional 'subject-verb-object' associative tables, aiming to preserve relational patterns (e.g. co-purchase behavior) for testing, augmentation, and privacy-compliant data sharing. It is built directly on SDV's single-table API, fitting and loading a CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema to produce the synthetic transactions.
